name: rafalmasiarek/captcha
description: Universal CAPTCHA verification for PHP: Google reCAPTCHA (v2/v3), Cloudflare Turnstile, and hCaptcha behind one Strategy-pattern facade. Built on rafalmasiarek/http-client.

suggest.rafalmasiarek/real-ip-resolver: Resolve the real client IP behind trusted reverse proxies instead of the naive SystemRemoteIpProvider default — wrap RealIpResolver::getIp() in a small adapter implementing RemoteIpProviderInterface.
